flags.why: Thẩm tra belongs to formal administrative or investigative language and needs a formal tag.
Thẩm tra means to investigate or verify, whereas interrogating a suspect is thẩm vấn.
Quân thù is an elevated literary expression for the enemy in war.
Learners commonly encounter cá biệt describing pupils with persistent behavioral problems.
flags.fix: Add an adjective sense: troublesome; badly behaved (especially of a pupil).

flags.why: Chừng mực commonly functions as an adjective describing restrained or moderate behavior.
flags.fix: Add an adjective sense: moderate; restrained, with the example 'Anh ấy nói năng rất chừng mực.' = 'He speaks in a very restrained manner.'
